route: Work permit (Department of Labour; Labour Act 2074, ss. 22-24; Labour Rules 2075)

permit.applies: The employer applies to the Department of Labour (or through a Nepalese embassy), after advertising
permit.first: The vacancy advertised in a national daily newspaper (copy uploaded to the Ministry of Labour's job portal), and no skilled Nepali citizen found
permit.eligibility: No performer criterion: the skill must be unobtainable from Nepali citizens after an advertisement in a national daily (s. 22(2)-(4)).
permit.pay: Pay and conditions may not fall below the standards the Labour Act or its Rules set (s. 27(1)).
permit.exemptNote: None for a performer: the Labour Act 2074 admits only diplomatic immunity and treaty exemptions (s. 23(2)); s. 24(b)'s short licence is for technicians.

sources.title: Pioneer Law Associates, Labor Laws of Nepal (presentation, 3 November 2021); rests on the Labour Act 2074, ss. 22-24, and the Labour Rules 2075
sources.said: General Provision (Section 22): - Advertisement in national level Daily Newspaper*, - if no skilled human resource Nepali citizen is found, submit an application to obtain work permit. *Copy of vacancy advertisement published in the daily newspaper should be uploaded in the Job Portal of the Ministry of Labor. … The maximum period of Work permit: 5 years for the expert in technical field and 3 years for others. … The Labor Rules requires foreign nationals to renew the work permit prior to 30 days of its expiry. … Up to 6 months NRs. 15,000 The amount should be paid in the convertible currency if the application for work permit is submitted in the Nepalese embassy or any diplomatic agency. More than 6 months NRs. 20,000

sources.title: Pradhan & Associates, Implementation of Labor Rules 2075 (2018); rests on the Labour Rules 2075
sources.said: Depending on the foreign national’s skills, the Labor Permit or Work Permit may be valid for a maximum period of 3 to 5 years and may be renewed for up to two years in special cases after obtaining approval from the Ministry of Labor, Employment and Social Security

sources.title: Nepal Law Commission text (www.lawcommission.gov.np header) of श्रम ऐन, २०७४ (Labour Act 2074, Act no. 14 of 2074), as amended to the Act of 2082, ch. 6, ss. 22-27, on the Government of Nepal's CDN (giwmscdnone.gov.np)
sources.said: [pdftotext of the text layer; the embedded Kalimati font maps some conjuncts imperfectly, e.g. 'हवदे िी' for विदेशी] २२. ... (३) ... रोजगारदाताले आफूलाई चाहहएको दि श्रममक नेपाली नागररकबाट प्राप्त गनध राहियस्तरको दै मनक पमत्रकामा हवज्ञापन प्रकािन गनुध पनेछ। ... (६) श्रम इजाजत सम्बन्धी दस्तुर तथा अन्य व्यवस्था तोहकए बमोशजम हुनेछ। २३. ... (२) यस ऐनमा अन्यत्र जुनसुकै कुरा ले शखएको भए तापमन कुटनीमतक उन्मुशि पाउने वा नेपाल सरकारसँग भएको कुनै सशन्ध वा सम्झौता अन्तगधत श्रम स्वीकृमत मलन नपने अवस्थामा बाहेक नेपालमा काम गने हवदे िी नागररकले तोहकए बमोशजम श्रम स्वीकृमत मलनु पनेछ। २४. ... (ख) तीन महहना वा सोभन्दा कम अवमधको लामग कुनै मेिीनरी सामान ममधत गनध वा नयाँ प्रहवमधको जडान गनध वा यस्तै अन्य आकशस्मक काम गनधको लामग आउने प्राहवमधक। ... २७. ... (१) हवदे िी श्रममकले काम गरे बापत पाउने पाररश्रममक, सेवाका ितध र सुहवधा यो ऐन वा यस ऐन अन्तगधत बनेको मनयमले मनधाधरण गरे को मापदण्डभन्दा घटी नहुने गरी रोजगारदाता र श्रममकबीच भएको समयगत वा कायधगत रोजगार सम्झौतामा उल्ले ख भए बमोशजम हुनेछ। (२) रोजगार सम्झौतामा समयावमध उल्ले ख भएकोमा सोही बमोशजम र नभएमा ्यस्तो रोजगार सम्झौता तीन वषधसम्म कायम रहनेछ।
